assetSet.name: Space Hauler Planet Assets
assetSet.description: Metadata for the planet game assets created for a space-themed video game.

sharedOrientation.rotationAxis: vertical, running from north pole at top to south pole at bottom

primaryLightSource.effect: left hemisphere is brighter and more illuminated

primaryShading.effect: right hemisphere falls into darker shadow

boundaryRules.planetFill: planet should fill nearly the full 1024x1024 canvas while remaining fully visible
boundaryRules.outsidePlanetBoundary: nothing should appear outside the planet boundary

planets.visualDescription: Frozen planet with glaciers, icy crust, pale blue-white coloration, polar ice formations, and cold surface texture.
planets.gamePurpose: Cold or frozen destination planet; suitable for mining, survival, or remote colony gameplay.

boundary.notes: No rings, dust clouds, moons, or external objects.

planets.visualDescription: Blue ocean planet dominated by water, with cloud systems and visible atmospheric swirl patterns over the surface.
planets.gamePurpose: Oceanic destination planet; suitable for aquatic colonies, rare resources, or trade missions.

boundary.notes: No rings, dust clouds, moons, or external objects.

planets.visualDescription: Dark volcanic planet with glowing lava fissures, molten cracks, blackened crust, and intense orange-red heat patterns.
planets.gamePurpose: Hazardous high-value resource planet; suitable for mining, danger zones, or hostile mission areas.

boundary.notes: No rings, dust clouds, moons, or external objects. Internal glow is contained within the planet silhouette.

planets.visualDescription: Large banded gas planet with swirling atmospheric belts, storm systems, and soft cloud-layer textures.
planets.gamePurpose: Gas giant destination or navigation landmark; suitable for fuel extraction, orbital stations, or hazard zones.

boundary.notes: No rings, dust clouds, moons, or external objects. Atmospheric details remain inside the circular planet boundary.

planets.visualDescription: Heavily industrialized planet covered with megacity structures, factories, orange city lights, smokestack-like silhouettes, and smog-like surface haze contained within the planet.
planets.gamePurpose: Civilized or corporate-controlled planet; suitable for trade hubs, manufacturing missions, upgrades, and faction activity.

lighting.secondaryEmission: city and industrial lights across the surface

boundary.notes: No rings, dust clouds, moons, or external objects. Smog and city glow should stay within the planet silhouette.

planets.visualDescription: Barren rocky planet with craters, mountain ranges, valleys, rough stone texture, and muted brown-gray coloration.
planets.gamePurpose: Mining or frontier planet; suitable for asteroid-adjacent routes, outposts, or resource extraction.

boundary.notes: No rings, dust clouds, moons, or external objects.

planets.visualDescription: Dry desert planet with golden sand tones, rocky plateaus, dune-like texture, crater marks, and warm tan-brown coloration.
planets.gamePurpose: Arid trade or survival planet; suitable for frontier settlements, smuggling routes, or sparse-resource gameplay.

boundary.notes: No rings, dust clouds, moons, or external objects. Any dust-storm-like texture should remain on the planet surface only.
